scope: Built demo-login web application with fresh SQLite API and separate report worker; virtual discovery/API requests rerouted only to loopback.
checks: Credential/header/key redaction is checked before any diagnostic can be retained.
Wrong password is refused; empty sign-in stays disabled and the passcode is cleared.
Browser visibility lifecycle covers the private DOM, waits for actual /v1/me, and restores the same mounted workspace.
A controlled foreground503 keeps private views covered; explicit retry rechecks the real service and restores the same DOM.
Separate worker prepares actual PDF/CSV; browser saves and parses protected artifacts at the current report revision.
Top Sign out closes private views and revokes the session while foreground access checking is stalled.
A real server-side account disablement closes private views on resume; a fresh login works after independent reactivation.
